states: Unexplored terrain before the scout arrives.
Friendly unit and building with different descriptor sight masks.
Enemy unit and building at raw brightness 32, 33 and a fractional sample above 32.
Aligned and half-cell scout positions at each edge of the sight mask.
Rightmost and bottommost playable tiles, including adjacent border samples.
Explored brightness at most 32 after scout departure or death.
Glow and daylight transitions, repeated with the other viewing side.
observe: Simulation tick, object identities and positions, descriptor mask ID and daylight key.
Four neighbouring brightness samples, interpolation weights and strict eligibility result.
Unit/building drawing, minimap terrain fog and object markers.
Mouse hover/picking, explicit target eligibility, autonomous acquisition and AI town/tactic choices.
Owned tactic selection excludes enemy members even when tactic numbers coincide.
Exact differing-pixel counts and tolerant metrics separately for terrain, objects and minimap.
blockers: Live reference execution is denied in the Codex sandbox; no reference samples or captures were collected.
V02/V10 shared observers and input adapters must establish tick, camera and state alignment before visual comparison.
The generator supplies initial placements only. Mask-edge, fractional, day/night and death states require a validated aligned input route; they are not claimed reachable by this scaffold.
Nearest/lower-ID/four-tick acquisition remains provisional; visual agreement alone cannot verify tactic scan or assignment parity.
